In the repository's own approved units, half a litre to one litre of saline undoes an hour of this bleeding: that is the FR-G finding, before any pressure map

current_scale.reading: arithmetic consistency only, no clinical diagnosis: under the committed map the accepted untreated course reaches its 2-hour state after shedding 7.5 % of the reference arrival volume and the core's zero-output boundary lies 578 mL-eq (14 %) below arrival

three_concepts.A: literal whole blood shed (shed_ml = rate x t): the repository calls it mL-EQUIVALENTS of modelled whole blood, not a measured flow
three_concepts.B: effective circulating deficit (volume_ml): shed minus refill, plus crystalloid and red cells when given
three_concepts.C: the model's V coordinate (kappa x volume_ml) and its position on the preload curve (V / scale): the ONLY thing pressure reads

amendment_3_decision.exact_reason: the absolute rate is identified only jointly with the pressure scale. On the joint manifold FR-G's protection falls as the scale grows (it reads retained / shed), and the response to red cells falls with it, because both are volume in the same millilitres. Inside every declared domain a closed-region crystalloid kernel still prevents 0.40 to 0.58 of the untreated fall; reaching one third needs a scale beyond the declared band, where two units of red cells raise pressure only a few mmHg above arrival. Where that trade is acceptable is a faculty anchor on the blood response, which this analysis cannot supply
